title: Distribution of PCR mastermix to MicroAmp 384 optical well plate or other plate
author: Opentrons
materials: Distribute mastermix to the target plate

steps.title: Configure distribution parameters
steps.instruction: Determine the number of wells to fill (rounded up to the nearest full column), the volume of mastermix to add per well (µL), whether to reuse tips, and the destination plate type (e.g., Applied Biosystems MicroAmp optical 384‑well 30 µL plate).

steps.title: Load 20 µL multi‑channel pipette
steps.instruction: Mount the 20 µL 8‑channel pipette on the left mount and ensure it is ready for tip pickup.

steps.title: Pick up or reuse tips
steps.instruction: Pick up a fresh set of tips with the pipette, or retain the already‑attached tips if the ‘reuse tips’ option is enabled.

steps.title: Aspirate mastermix from source reservoir
steps.instruction: Aspirate the chosen volume of PCR mastermix from the NEST 12‑well source reservoir using the 20 µL multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Dispense mastermix into target wells
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated mastermix into the selected wells of the destination plate, adding the specified volume to each well.

steps.title: Dispose or retain tips
steps.instruction: If tip reuse is disabled, drop the tips into waste; if reuse is enabled, keep the tips for the next aspiration.

steps.title: Repeat distribution until complete
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 3–6 (or 4–6) until all designated wells have received mastermix.
